description: OpenBSE is an experimental Rust building-energy simulation engine. Its README explicitly states that the code and documentation were generated with AI, apart from a small identified human contribution. The repository presents physics and validation claims, but this review found no independent evidence sufficient to treat the engine as an established engineering tool. Use remains a research decision. Published by bbrannon4 (repository owner). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Documentation is accessible through the linked paper or repository; executable access is limited to what that source states. Reuse licence: MIT. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include climate adaptation, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-energyplus. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
